objections.objection: What makes Playermaker better than GPS trackers?
objections.answer: Playermaker works both indoors and outdoors, so you can use it anywhere you train or play. Unlike GPS trackers that sit on your chest and mainly measure running distance and top speed, Playermaker is mounted directly on your shoes, capturing every touch, pass, turn, and kick with precision. By tracking data from the true source of motion - your feet - Playermaker doesn’t just measure the volume and intensity of your actions, it also evaluates your technique. This unique ability helps you not only understand how much and how hard you perform, but also how well you execute, giving you clear guidance to improve both your physical and technical game.

objections.objection: What type of data does Playermaker track?
objections.answer: Playermaker tracks both technical and physical performance, providing a complete picture of your game. It records your ball touches, passing, shooting, dribbling, first touch, two-footed use, and kicking velocity, as well as distance covered, sprints, accelerations, decelerations, power, intensity, and more.

objections.objection: How is Playermaker different from GPS vest trackers?
objections.answer: Playermaker tracks everything a GPS vest does — distance, speed, sprint count, and more — but adds what GPS can’t: true football technique analysis. Mounted on your boots, Playermaker measures movement from its real source — your feet. This allows it to capture every touch, pass, turn, and kick with millisecond precision. By combining physical data (distance, speed, intensity) with technical insight (technique quality, foot usage, ball control), Playermaker reveals how you perform — not just how much you move. Its advanced algorithms deliver personalized feedback on your speed mechanics, change of direction, first touch, and overall technique — helping you train smarter and improve faster.

objections.objection: How accurate is Playermaker?
objections.answer: Playermaker’s 6-axis smart sensors sample 1,000 times per second, tracking impact, ball contact, and foot rotation with exceptional precision. Independent scientific research from leading universities and sports performance labs has validated Playermaker’s data, showing up to 98% accuracy — often outperforming traditional GPS vest systems. The system is FIFA Quality certified and trusted by some of the world’s top clubs, academies, and sports organizations, following rigorous testing and validation by elite sports scientists. It even includes built-in self-checks to ensure data integrity — detecting incorrect mounting or sensor placement and automatically excluding inaccurate sessions.

objections.objection: How long does the battery last?

objections.objection: What metrics does Playermaker track?

objections.objection: What is the Playermaker Scoring System?

As you record more matches, your scores evolve — reflecting your real development over time.

objections.objection: Do I need my phone with me to record a session?

Advanced AI algorithms automatically filter out any irrelevant or idle time, so only your real activity is analysed. Just charge, wear, play — Playermaker does the rest.
